methods.complete: Complete observation generation and mapped curve accumulation
methods.batch: Complete generation with retained raw observations for mapping/reuse
methods.bits: Cached bisection in float32 bit order
methods.value: Cached bisection in numeric value space

alpha4.order: gamma outer loop, alpha inner loop

mixed16.order: gamma outer loop, alpha inner loop

measurement_boundaries.active: Active calibration wall time in seconds, including state construction/destruction, coarse ordering, scans, accounting, scheduling, caching, mapping, and sorting; excludes input loading, warmup, and output.
measurement_boundaries.joint: Direct wall time from before index/input loading through calibration-state destruction, including warmup and fresh labels/certificates when requested; excludes index construction and final output.
